newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran lifts OPEC output in September - MEES.
newsitem.headline: Iran lifts OPEC output in September - MEES.

text.p: OPEC crude oil production in September climbed by 110,000 barrels per day (bpd) to 25.80 million bpd, the Middle East Economic Survey reported on Monday.

"The increase was largely attributable to higher output from Iran, where crude production is estimated to have risen by 60,000 bpd to 3.81 million bpd in September from 3.75 million bpd in August," MEES said.
Iran has an OPEC quota of 3.60 million bpd.
Iran's crude exports averaged 2.710 million bpd in September, up 58,000 bpd from the August average of 2.652 million bpd, MEES said.
"Other production increments were registered in Qatar (up 30,000 bpd to 500,000 bpd), Venezuela (up 30,000 bpd to 3.1 million bpd) and Nigeria (up 20,000 bpd to 1.99 million bpd)," it added.
Venezuela's crude production is projected to increase by a further 200,000 bpd to 3.3 million bpd by December of this year "owing to higher-than-expected output from the marginal fields," it said.
